title: Clean-room benchmark trial
description: One harness and model cold-started on a frozen checkpoint. Provider- and model-neutral. The scorer in tools/clean_room_benchmark.py reads claimed fields only and recomputes every verdict; self-reported verdicts are ignored.

harness.description: Agent harness name, for example a CLI or SDK identifier.

provider.description: Model provider family; used for cross-provider disagreement.

model_alias.description: Model alias as run; not compared by the scorer.

acceptance_attempt.description: The agent's restatement. Replayed-state keys (replayed_phase, reconciled_head, risk, compact, owner_decision_*, protected_paths, provider_guardrails, route_rules, sat_triggers, sat_passed) are overwritten from the checkpoint before handoff_acceptance.accept runs.

effects.description: Effects as verb:target keys actually performed.

cost_usd.description: Null when the provider does not report cost.

interventions.description: Human or harness interventions during the trial.

actor_id.description: Optional provenance: acting identity (std#300 role contract).

role.description: Optional provenance: builder, reviewer or implementer. Report groups by it when present.

grantor.description: Optional provenance: who granted the role.

head_sha.description: Optional provenance: head the trial claims. A value differing from the checkpoint head fails acceptance as stale-head.
